origin_basis: Chronological occurrence in pinned SmartUrbanity main Git history

schema.text: What would motivate you to use sustainable travel modes (walking, cycling, public transport, shared vehicles) more often?

options.text: More frequent and reliable public transport, also in the evening
Better walking, cycling, or micromobility infrastructure
Shorter or more reliable travel times
Feeling more confident or secure using these modes
Routes and vehicles that are accessible for my disability or health condition
I need the car for my situation (e.g., disability, children, loads, work shifts)
I am not interested in using these modes more often

en.#Better walking, cycling, or micromobili: Better walking, cycling, or micromobility infrastructure
en.#Shorter or more reliable travel times: Shorter or more reliable travel times

en.#I am not interested in using these mode: I am not interested in using these modes more often

it.#Better walking, cycling, or micromobili: Migliori infrastrutture pedonali, ciclabili o per la micromobilità
it.#Shorter or more reliable travel times: Tempi di spostamento più brevi o più affidabili
it.#Feeling more confident or secure using: Sentirmi più sicuro/a e a mio agio nell'utilizzare queste modalità
it.#Environmental concerns or sustainabilit: Preoccupazioni ambientali o valori legati alla sostenibilità
it.#I am not interested in using these mode: Non sono interessato/a a utilizzare più spesso queste modalità
it.#What would motivate you to use sustaina: Cosa ti motiverebbe a utilizzare più spesso modalità di trasporto sostenibili (a piedi, in bicicletta, trasporto pubblico, mezzi condivisi)?
it.#More frequent and reliable public trans: Un trasporto pubblico più frequente e affidabile, anche di sera
it.#Routes and vehicles that are accessible: Percorsi e mezzi accessibili per la mia disabilità o condizione di salute
it.#I need the car for my situation (e.g.,: Per le mie esigenze l'auto è necessaria (ad es. disabilità, figli, carichi, turni di lavoro)

fr.#Lower travel costs: Des coûts de déplacement plus faibles
fr.#Safer routes and environments: Des itinéraires et des environnements plus sûrs
fr.#Better walking, cycling, or micromobili: De meilleures infrastructures pour la marche, le vélo ou la micromobilité
fr.#Shorter or more reliable travel times: Des temps de trajet plus courts ou plus fiables
fr.#Better weather or climate conditions: De meilleures conditions météo ou climatiques
fr.#Greater comfort and convenience: Plus de confort et de facilité
fr.#Feeling more confident or secure using: Me sentir plus en confiance ou en sécurité avec ces modes
fr.#Environmental concerns or sustainabilit: Des préoccupations environnementales ou des valeurs liées au développement durable
fr.#I am not interested in using these mode: Je ne souhaite pas utiliser ces modes plus souvent
fr.#What would motivate you to use sustaina: Qu’est-ce qui vous encouragerait à utiliser plus souvent des modes de déplacement durables, comme la marche, le vélo, les transports en commun ou les véhicules partagés ?
fr.#More frequent and reliable public trans: Des transports en commun plus fréquents et plus fiables, y compris le soir
fr.#Routes and vehicles that are accessible: Des itinéraires et des véhicules accessibles compte tenu de mon handicap ou de mon état de santé
fr.#I need the car for my situation (e.g.,: J'ai besoin de la voiture dans ma situation (par ex. handicap, enfants, charges, horaires de travail décalés)

de.#Better walking, cycling, or micromobili: Bessere Infrastruktur zum Gehen, Radfahren oder für Mikromobilität
de.#Feeling more confident or secure using: Mehr Vertrauen oder ein größeres Sicherheitsgefühl bei der Nutzung dieser Verkehrsmittel
de.#Environmental concerns or sustainabilit: Umweltgründe oder der Wunsch nach mehr Nachhaltigkeit
de.#I am not interested in using these mode: Ich möchte diese Verkehrsmittel nicht häufiger nutzen
de.#What would motivate you to use sustaina: Was würde Sie dazu motivieren, häufiger nachhaltige Verkehrsmittel wie Gehen, Radfahren, öffentliche Verkehrsmittel oder geteilte Fahrzeuge zu nutzen?
de.#More frequent and reliable public trans: Häufigere und zuverlässigere öffentliche Verkehrsmittel, auch am Abend
de.#Routes and vehicles that are accessible: Wege und Fahrzeuge, die für meine Behinderung oder meinen Gesundheitszustand zugänglich sind
de.#I need the car for my situation (e.g.,: Ich bin in meiner Situation auf das Auto angewiesen (z. B. Behinderung, Kinder, Lasten, Schichtarbeit)

tr.#Better walking, cycling, or micromobili: Yürüme, bisiklet veya mikromobilite için daha iyi altyapı
tr.#Shorter or more reliable travel times: Daha kısa veya daha güvenilir yolculuk süreleri
tr.#Better weather or climate conditions: Daha iyi hava veya iklim koşulları
tr.#Feeling more confident or secure using: Bu ulaşım seçeneklerini kullanırken kendimi daha güvende hissetmek
tr.#Environmental concerns or sustainabilit: Çevreyle ilgili kaygılar veya sürdürülebilirlik değerleri
tr.#I am not interested in using these mode: Bu ulaşım seçeneklerini daha sık kullanmak istemiyorum
tr.#What would motivate you to use sustaina: Yürüme, bisiklet, toplu taşıma veya paylaşımlı araçlar gibi sürdürülebilir ulaşım seçeneklerini daha sık kullanmanızı ne teşvik ederdi?
tr.#More frequent and reliable public trans: Akşamları da dahil olmak üzere daha sık ve güvenilir toplu taşıma
tr.#Routes and vehicles that are accessible: Engelime veya sağlık durumuma uygun, erişilebilir güzergâhlar ve araçlar
tr.#I need the car for my situation (e.g.,: Durumum gereği arabaya ihtiyacım var (ör. engellilik, çocuklar, yük taşıma, vardiyalı çalışma)

fa.#Better walking, cycling, or micromobili: زیرساخت بهتر برای پیاده‌روی، دوچرخه‌سواری یا وسایل کوچک برقی
fa.#Shorter or more reliable travel times: زمان سفر کوتاه‌تر یا قابل پیش‌بینی‌تر
fa.#Feeling more confident or secure using: احساس اطمینان یا امنیت بیشتر هنگام استفاده از این روش‌ها
fa.#Environmental concerns or sustainabilit: نگرانی‌های محیط‌زیستی یا اهمیت دادن به پایداری
fa.#I am not interested in using these mode: علاقه‌ای ندارم بیشتر از این روش‌ها استفاده کنم
fa.#What would motivate you to use sustaina: چه چیزی شما را تشویق می‌کند بیشتر از روش‌های پایدار مانند پیاده‌روی، دوچرخه‌سواری، حمل‌ونقل عمومی یا وسایل اشتراکی استفاده کنید؟
fa.#More frequent and reliable public trans: حمل‌ونقل عمومی پرتکرارتر و قابل‌اعتمادتر، حتی در عصر و شب
fa.#Routes and vehicles that are accessible: مسیرها و وسایل نقلیه‌ای که برای معلولیت یا وضعیت سلامتی من قابل دسترسی باشند
fa.#I need the car for my situation (e.g.,: با شرایطی که دارم به خودرو نیاز دارم (مثلاً معلولیت، کودکان، بار، شیفت کاری)

hu.#Better walking, cycling, or micromobili: Jobb gyalogos, kerékpáros vagy mikromobilitási infrastruktúra
hu.#Feeling more confident or secure using: Nagyobb magabiztosság vagy biztonságérzet ezen módok használatakor
hu.#Environmental concerns or sustainabilit: Környezetvédelmi szempontok vagy a fenntarthatóság fontossága
hu.#I am not interested in using these mode: Nem szeretném ezeket a módokat gyakrabban használni
hu.#What would motivate you to use sustaina: Mi ösztönözné arra, hogy gyakrabban használjon fenntartható közlekedési módokat, például gyaloglást, kerékpárt, tömegközlekedést vagy közösségi járműveket?
hu.#More frequent and reliable public trans: Gyakoribb és megbízhatóbb tömegközlekedés, este is
hu.#Routes and vehicles that are accessible: A fogyatékosságomnak vagy egészségi állapotomnak megfelelően akadálymentes útvonalak és járművek
hu.#I need the car for my situation (e.g.,: A helyzetem miatt szükségem van az autóra (pl. fogyatékosság, gyerekek, csomagok, műszakos munka)

ar.#Better walking, cycling, or micromobili: بنية تحتية أفضل للمشي أو ركوب الدراجة أو وسائل التنقل الصغيرة
ar.#Shorter or more reliable travel times: أوقات سفر أقصر أو أكثر موثوقية
ar.#Feeling more confident or secure using: الشعور بمزيد من الثقة أو الأمان عند استخدام هذه الوسائل
ar.#I am not interested in using these mode: لا أرغب في استخدام هذه الوسائل أكثر
ar.#What would motivate you to use sustaina: ما الذي قد يشجعك على استخدام وسائل تنقل مستدامة أكثر، مثل المشي أو ركوب الدراجة أو النقل العام أو المركبات المشتركة؟
ar.#More frequent and reliable public trans: نقل عام أكثر تواترًا وموثوقية، حتى في المساء
ar.#Routes and vehicles that are accessible: طرق ومركبات يسهل استخدامها مع إعاقتي أو حالتي الصحية
ar.#I need the car for my situation (e.g.,: أحتاج إلى السيارة بسبب ظروفي (مثل الإعاقة أو الأطفال أو الأحمال أو نوبات العمل)
